title: Diff-IrisPAD: Modeling Bona Fide Iris Distributions for Unsupervised Presentation Attack Detection
title_zh: Diff-IrisPAD：为无监督呈现攻击检测建模真实虹膜分布

paragraphs.en: Diff-IrisPAD基于布朗桥扩散无监督建模真实虹膜分布，无需攻击样本即可检测多种呈现攻击。 Iris recognition systems are vulnerable to presentation attacks (PAs), including textured contact lenses, print replays, and synthetic irises. Existing PAD methods rely on supervised learning with attack data, limiting generalization to unseen attacks and new sensors. We propose Diff-IrisPAD, an unsupervised framework based on Brownian Bridge Diffusion that models bona fide iris distributions without using attack samples. The method reconstructs clean iris textures from degraded inputs and detects attacks via reconstruction inconsistency using ViT scoring and pixel-level measures. Experiments on a large-scale multi-sensor dataset (125K+ images, NIR and VIS, 8 attack types) show that Diff-IrisPAD achieves an overall ACER of 30.52, significantly outperforming diffusion-based baselines while demonstrating strong generalization to unseen attacks. These results highlight the effectiveness of diffusion-based bona fide modeling for robust and scalable iris PAD.
paragraphs.zh: Diff-IrisPAD基于布朗桥扩散无监督建模真实虹膜分布，无需攻击样本即可检测多种呈现攻击。虹膜识别系统容易受到呈现攻击（PA）的威胁，包括纹理隐形眼镜、打印回放和合成虹膜。 现有的PAD方法依赖使用攻击数据的监督学习，限制了对未见攻击和新传感器的泛化能力。 我们提出Diff-IrisPAD，这是一个基于布朗桥扩散的无监督框架，在不使用攻击样本的情况下建模真实虹膜分布。 该方法从退化输入重建干净的虹膜纹理，并利用ViT评分和像素级度量通过重建不一致性检测攻击。 在一个大规模多传感器数据集（超过12.5万张图像，涵盖近红外和可见光，8种攻击类型）上的实验表明，Diff-IrisPAD取得了30.52的总体ACER，显著优于基于扩散的基线方法，同时对未见攻击展现出强大的泛化能力。 这些结果凸显了基于扩散的真实分布建模在实现鲁棒且可扩展的虹膜PAD方面的有效性。
